caption: The drawing depicts a single ceramic bowl, shown in a three-quarters view so that both the interior and exterior are visible. The inside of the bowl is a smooth light brown or tan color, with some subtle shading that suggests roundness and dimensionality. The outside of the bowl is a dark green, almost black, with a glossy appearance indicating a glazed finish. The bowl has a wide, open mouth, thick walls, and a rounded body that narrows slightly towards the base. Around the rim, there is a raised, undulating decorative feature, which includes a wavy protrusion on the closest side. The background of the drawing is plain off-white, providing a neutral setting with no additional objects or details.
title: Economite Bowl or Cake Mold
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
